title: SRS View Definition (ext:views-l1)
description: A versioned presentation and export configuration over a field set. A View is compatible with any record containing its required fields.

id.description: Stable UUID for this View. Never changes across versions.

name.description: Machine-readable name within the namespace, kebab-case.

description.description: When to use this View; what workflow or audience it serves.

compatibleTypes.description: Optional semanticObjectType hints this View was designed for. Informational only; not a compatibility constraint.

fieldViews.description: Presentation configuration for fields and record-level properties. Field rows omitted here are treated as visible: false.

aiGuidance.description: Guidance for AI agents using this View.

fieldId.description: Must reference a valid Field.id in the effective package set.

required.description: View-level workflow constraint; does not alter the Field contract.

visible.description: Default: true. A hidden field remains in the Record and may appear in other Views.

editorHintOverride.description: Presentation only (Invariant 13, extended by RFC-036 [CR-036-20]). Supersedes Field.editorHint for Records rendered or edited through this View. RFC-036 [CR-036-21]: the value MUST come from the same set as Field.editorHint (singleline, textarea, rich-text, date-picker, dropdown, multi-select, voice); a value outside that set is ignored with a diagnostic and Field.editorHint applies. Deliberately not constrained to an enum here so an unrecognised value does not fail the load of the whole View.

compositeRenderer.description: RFC-036 — render this field's composite-range value through a named composite renderer. Highest-precedence declaration site (RFC-036 [CR-036-6]). Valid only on a Field whose fieldType.datatype is 'ref' and mode is 'inline' ([CR-036-3]).

property.description: Record-level property presented by this row. The closed enum is generated from record.json by scripts/gen-record-property-view-enum.mjs.

order.description: Display order within this View, on the same axis as FieldView.order.

displayLabel.description: Overrides the default label for this record-level property.

visible.description: Default: true. When false, this record-level property row is hidden.

CompositeRendererBinding.description: RFC-036 Change A (ext:views-l1) — a view-owned composite rendering dispatch record. Presentation only: it MUST NOT affect validity, field values, Relations, or Discovery Text Projection ([CR-036-20]).

renderer.description: Composite renderer identifier. Bare lower-kebab names are SRS-reserved and introduced only by a ratified RFC ('table', and the sentinel 'baseline' meaning explicitly no renderer); vendor identifiers use '{reverse-domain}/{name}' with at least two reverse-domain labels. The grammar ^([a-z][a-z0-9-]*|[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+/[^/]+)$ is enforced at render and validation time rather than here ([CR-036-1]), so a malformed or unknown value falls back to the composite baseline with a diagnostic ([CR-036-7]) instead of failing the load.

roles.description: Explicit, UUID-anchored role -> Field.id binding, overriding the by-name defaults of [CR-036-8]. Role names are defined by the renderer; the 'table' renderer defines rows and cells (required) plus columns, widths, subheading and label. A role the renderer does not define is silently ignored.

ExportConfig.description: Configuration for rendering a Record through this View as an exportable document.

format.description: Target output format. Portable values: 'markdown', 'adoc', 'html', 'text'. In section rendering context (ext:views-l2), DocumentView.format supersedes this value.

preamble.description: Template string rendered before field values. Standard variables: {{instance-id}}, {{date}}, {{status}}, {{namespace}}, {{name}}. In section rendering context, {{heading-3}} is also available (resolves to heading level 3 + depthOffset).

fieldOrder.description: Explicit export field ordering by fieldId. Defaults to fieldViews[].order.

omitEmptyFields.description: Default: false. When true, fields with no value are omitted from output.
